# A window after html's document is a `<dialog>` in it, run in Chromium and on
# the interpreter, which holds it to the same answers, and on fyne and gtk4,
# where it is a toplevel of its own. A test's component may be a root
# component, and its windows' handles are reached through it like any other
# node's: a read of `c.log.visible` is the cell the window keeps for it.
#
# `log` starts hidden and `open`/`close` through its `#id` show and hide it,
# writing the cell it keeps for its `visible`; a close the program makes is no
# close the user made, so `@closed` does not run. `main` is the document, and
# `main.close()` writes its cell while the document stays where it is. A
# window under an `if` over state is created with the condition and destroyed
# with it, the effect in it included, and starts again from nothing.
#
# testdata/window_several.txtar, window_visible.txtar and window_under_if.txtar
# are the code.

sngl test --platform=none app.sngl
stdout '3 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=html app.sngl
stdout '3 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=fyne --language=go app.sngl
stdout '3 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=gtk4 --language=go app.sngl
stdout '3 tests, 0 failures'

# bubbletea and android show one window, and refuse the second.
! sngl test --platform=bubbletea --language=go app.sngl
stderr 'bubbletea shows one window, and this is a second'

-- app.sngl --
import . "sngl:test"
import ui "sngl:ui"

component app root {
    var closes = 0
    var details = false
    var mounts = 0

    ui.window #main(title="Main") {
        ui.text(value="closed {closes}")
        ui.button #show(text="Log", @click {
            log.open()
        })
        ui.button #hideMain(text="Hide main", @click {
            main.close()
        })
        ui.button #toggle(text="Details", @click {
            details = !details
        })
    }

    ui.window #log(title="Log", visible=false, @closed {
        closes += 1
    }) {
        ui.button #hide(text="Hide", @click {
            log.close()
        })
    }

    if details {
        ui.window(title="Details") {
            ui.text(value="details")
            effect(@mount {
                mounts += 1
            })
        }
    }
}


func testOpenAndCloseADialog(t Test, c app) {
    t.assert(!c.log.visible)
    c.show.click()
    t.assert(c.log.visible)
    c.hide.click()
    t.assert(!c.log.visible)
    t.assert(c.closes == 0)
}

func testTheDocumentWindowKeepsItsCell(t Test, c app) {
    t.assert(c.main.visible)
    c.hideMain.click()
    t.assert(!c.main.visible)
}

func testADialogUnderAnIfComesAndGoes(t Test, c app) {
    t.assert(c.mounts == 0)
    c.toggle.click()
    t.assert(c.mounts == 1)
    c.toggle.click()
    c.toggle.click()
    t.assert(c.mounts == 2)
}
